page.title: Inverted index
page.text: An inverted index maps each term to the documents and positions where it occurs. It is the data structure that makes keyword search possible at any corpus size.

page.title: Computer science
page.text: Computer science is the study of computation. The computer science department teaches algorithms and data structures.

page.title: Porter stemmer
page.text: The Porter stemming algorithm reduces inflected words to a common form, so connect and connecting meet on one term.

page.title: Gardening
page.text: Gardening involves growing plants in a garden. Roses and tulips are popular flowers.

page.title: Term frequency
page.text: Term frequency and inverse document frequency together weight how well a term describes a document. Rare terms weigh more.

page.title: Special characters & entities
page.text: An ampersand & a less-than < sign should survive unescaping.
